jobs.title: Customer Implementation Specialist, Single Location
jobs.description:
An Implementation Specialist is responsible for guiding new Weave customers through the implementation, training, and activation of the Weave platform during the onboarding process. This role serves as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, ensuring our customers are properly configured, trained, and prepared to successfully adopt scheduling, texting, and communication workflows. You will manage a portfolio of Single Location Customers at various stages of implementation, balancing project management, customer education, technical troubleshooting, and go-live execution. Success in this role is measured by customer adoption, implementation quality, customer satisfaction, and long-term retention

- Hybrid position: M/T/W in office and Th/F are WFH

- Schedule: 7:00am–4:00pm MT or 8:00am–5:00pm MT

- Reports to: Manager of Implementation, Single

What You Will Own

- Serve as the primary implementation specialist and trusted advisor from kickoff through go-live.

- Manage a portfolio of Single Location Customers in various stages of onboarding.

- Lead customer training and activation calls for Weave products.

- Configure and activate Weave systems.

- Troubleshoot implementation issues and partner with Product, Support, Operations, and Engineering teams when necessary.

- Proactively manage customer expectations and communicate implementation milestones.

- Handle customer escalations and adoption concerns.

- Ensure customers understand how to maximize the value of Weave’s features

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong technical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot software workflows.

- Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate in a fast-changing environment.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Ability to build trust and influence customer behavior.

- Demonstrated ability to drive customer adoption and outcomes.

- Experience handling escalated customer situations.

CORE COMPETENCIES

- Customer Focus

- Project Management

- Accountability

- Problem Solving

- Adaptability

- Communication

- Ability to thrive in a pilot environment and help shape evolving processes.

- Strong relationship-building skills with both customers and teammates.

jobs.title: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) will lead Weave’s next phase of growth by evolving our marketing engine into a scalable, efficient, and vertically differentiated growth platform. As a key member of the executive team, this leader will partner closely with the CRO in shared accountability for pipeline and revenue outcomes, strengthening our inbound foundation while expanding product-led and partner-driven growth. The CMO will strengthen Weave’s brand across SMB and large-group healthcare practices, including DSOs, VSOs, MSOs, and adjacent healthcare verticals, while elevating marketing’s strategic impact with the executive team and Board. This leader will play a critical role in positioning Weave as an AI leader in healthcare communications and practice growth, translating product innovation into clear market differentiation and category leadership. The role requires a modern marketing executive who can scale proven strengths, modernize areas of opportunity, and leverage AI, data, and automation to build a more intelligent, disciplined marketing engine for sustained long-term growth. This leader must also be adept at responding to disruption and transformation across the marketing landscape, including the shift from traditional SEO to GEO, and ensure Weave stays ahead of how customers discover, evaluate, and engage with our brand.

This position will be: In office - Utah Based

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Define and execute a multi-year marketing strategy aligned to company growth, efficiency, and market expansion goals.

- Partner with the CRO in shared accountability for pipeline creation and revenue performance, aligning inbound, outbound, lifecycle, and emerging product-led motions.

- Evolve Weave’s inbound-led growth engine to improve efficiency, reduce cost structure, and increase predictable pipeline contribution.

- Strengthen Weave’s brand positioning across SMB and large-group healthcare verticals (medical, dental, optometry, veterinary), ensuring differentiated and compelling market presence.

- Lead product marketing strategy, including vertical go-to-market execution, competitive positioning, messaging clarity, and launch excellence.

- Expand lifecycle and customer marketing programs to drive adoption, expansion, and long-term retention.

- Lead the development of a compelling and evolving IR and PR narrative that strengthens investor confidence, shapes market perception, and positions Weave as the AI leader in healthcare communications.

- Support marketing strategy related to potential M&A activity, including brand integration, messaging alignment, and go-to-market coordination.

- Drive performance across digital, content, creative, events, communications, and partner marketing channels with clear ROI accountability.

- Develop and mentor a ~50 person marketing organization, strengthening leadership bench and operational discipline.

- Establish clear KPIs that tie marketing investment to pipeline velocity, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, and overall revenue contribution.

- Represent Marketing in executive and Board discussions, translating strategy and performance into clear business outcomes.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 15+ years of progressive marketing leadership experience, including senior executive experience within a B2B SaaS organization.

- Proven success scaling a multi-channel marketing engine in an inbound-led environment with meaningful outbound partnership.

- Demonstrated ability to improve marketing efficiency and optimize cost structure while sustaining growth.

- Experience serving SMB markets, driving successful up-market expansion, and leading verticalized go-to-market strategies.

- Strong partnership track record with Sales leadership, including shared accountability for pipeline and revenue commitments.

- Deep expertise in demand generation, product marketing, brand strategy, and growth analytics.

- Experience presenting to and engaging with Boards of Directors.

- Experience supporting or leading marketing efforts related to M&A integration is strongly preferred.

- Track record of building and developing high-performing marketing leadership teams.

- Strong financial acumen and excellence in managing significant marketing budgets with ROI discipline.

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- Fire in the belly

- You think like a business leader first, aligning marketing strategy directly to revenue, profitability, and long-term enterprise value.

- You scale growth with financial discipline and measurable return on investment.

- You are comfortable committing to pipeline and revenue outcomes alongside Sales — and owning the results together.

- You know how to strengthen what’s working while confidently evolving what needs to change.

- You can verticalize go-to-market strategy without diluting brand clarity.

- You build operating rigor into the marketing engine — clear metrics, accountability, and repeatability.

- You are credible in the Boardroom and compelling with frontline teams.

- You develop strong leaders and elevate the performance bar across your organization.

- You bring calm, clarity, and decisiveness in moments of scale and complexity.

jobs.title: Senior ML - GenAI Engineer, Voice & Speech
jobs.description:
Weave is looking for engineers hungry for fun challenges who can join our self-empowered teams and contribute in both technical and non-technical ways.

You will be joining a team of talented developers that share a common interest in distributed backend systems, data, scalability, and continued development. You will get a chance to apply these and other skills to new and ongoing projects to make machine learning more approachable, data more available, and easier to discover and use by helping design how teams build out AI-powered features at Weave.

Our teams are cross-functional agile teams composed of a product owner, backend and frontend devs and DevOps. Teams are highly autonomous with the ownership and ability to act in Weave’s best interest.

Above all, your work will impact the way our customers experience Weave while working closely with a highly skilled team to accomplish varying goals and cultivate our phenomenal culture.

PURPOSE

The Machine Learning Team's mission is to enable product innovation by making it painless for developers to build AI-powered applications that require access to large sets of data. Machine learning is challenging, but we are striving to democratize access to the tools and technology that power it so teams can build cutting-edge features safely and responsibly without a PhD in Data Science. As a Machine Learning Engineer on the team, you’ll be building models for new products with emerging technologies, at scale. We handle data for hundreds of millions of people daily.

- This position will be available fully remote in the US with an opportunity to work in an office if located near the Lehi, UT Headquarters.

- Reports to: Engineering Director

What You Will Own

- Design and develop machine learning infrastructure, tooling, and models to help teams deliver world-class experiences.

- Help product and development teams understand the data lifecycle and the inherent experimental nature of machine learning.

- Build internal products and platforms to enable teams to incorporate AI into their features and customer-facing products.

- Consult with teams to help them understand common patterns, anti-patterns, and trade-offs of machine learning. Guide them through creating excellent customer experiences end to end.

- Build scalable, resilient services to support data integration, event processing, and platform extensions.

- Contribute to the continued evolution of product functionality that services large amounts of data and traffic.

- Write code that is high-quality, performant, sustainable, and testable while holding yourself accountable for the quality of the code you produce.

- Coach and collaborate inside and outside the team. You enjoy working closely with others - helping them grow by sharing expertise and encouraging best practices.

- Work in a cloud environment, considering the implementation of functionality through several distributed components and services.

- Work with our stakeholders to translate product goals into actionable engineering plans.

What You Will Need to Accomplish the Job

- High integrity, team-focused approach, and collaboration skills to build tight-knit relationships across Weave with various roles and stakeholders.

- Responsive person with a strong bias for action.

- 5+ years of experience in any structured back-end language, i.e. Go, Java or Python (Go and Python experience is a plus).

- Experience moving and storing TBs of data or 100 M to 10 B records.

- Experience building and deploying ML-driven B2B multi-tenant applications in production environments.

- Experience with common ML technologies such as Python, Jupyter, Workflow Engines (Dagster, MLflow, Kubeflow, etc.), DVC, Triton Server, LLMs, Postgres, and others.

- Experience with modern ML tools and techniques such as LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, fine-tuning, multimodal models, and others.

- Experience with data labelling or annotation for audio or text use cases.

- Understanding of distributed systems and building scalable, redundant, and observable services.

- Expertise in designing and architecting systems for distributed data sets and services.

- Experience building solutions to run on one or more of the public clouds (e.g., AWS, GCP, etc.).

- Experience providing stable, well-designed libraries and SDKs for internal use.

- Self-driven and a thirst for learning in a quickly changing industry.

- Demonstrated track record of delivering complex projects on time and experience working in enterprise-grade production environments.

- Strategic thinker with a strong technical aptitude and a passion for execution.

What Will Make Us Love You

- A background in data analysis, visualization, and presentation.

- 3+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics in addition to engineering experience.

- Experience with natural language models, embeddings, and inference in production, at scale.

- Experience with real-time audio models and voice use cases such as transcription, ASR pipelines with interruption detection, audio alignment, and speech synthesis.

- Experience with emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- Proficient understanding of containers, orchestrators, and usage patterns at scale, including networking, storage, service meshes, and multi-cluster communication. Experience with Kubernetes or GKE and the Operator Pattern (GCP), specifically, is a plus.

- Experience with highly sensitive data such as PHI (HIPAA) and PII data.

- Experience with automation and container-based workflow engines.

- Experience with GitOps, IaC, and configuration-driven systems.

- A preference for open source solutions.

- A track record of clean abstractions and simple-to-use APIs.

- Deep understanding of distributed data technologies such as streaming, data mesh, data lakes, warehouses, or distributed machine learning.

- A desire to advance the state of the art with new and innovative technologies.

- Enjoys working in a greenfield environment using rapid prototyping.

- Enjoys working with open-ended, evolving problems and domains.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Applications
jobs.description:
Weave is a leading all-in-one customer experience and payments software platform for small and medium-sized healthcare businesses (SMBs). We are seeking a Principal Engineer to serve as a technical cornerstone of our Applications Fellowship—the domain responsible for key patient-facing and practice-facing features, including RCM Experiences (Payments and Insurance Verification), Scheduling, Forms, Team Chat, Task Center, and Mobile App features for 40,000+ healthcare practices. This is not a role for someone seeking a larger individual contributor scope; it's a role for someone who shapes technical strategy at the company level, influences architectural decisions across multiple teams, and solves the hardest problems that span organizational boundaries.

As a Principal Engineer, you will own the multi-year technical vision for the applications domain, including core systems for Payments and Scheduling, ensuring architectural decisions position Weave for long-term competitive advantage. You'll partner with Engineering Directors, Staff Engineers, and Product leadership to ensure our technical decisions position Weave for long-term competitive advantage. Your success will be measured not by your personal output, but by how the organization's technical capability grows through your influence, mentorship, and strategic leadership.

This role requires someone with impeccable technical judgment, the ability to operate in ambiguity, and the character to lead through influence rather than authority. You'll be a visible leader whose approach to problem-solving becomes the template for how engineering operates at Weave.

The Applications Fellowship encompasses multiple engineering teams responsible for building and scaling our user-facing products: Payments, Scheduling, Forms, Business Experience, Mobile Apps, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). You will work across these teams as a technical leader, partnering with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to drive architectural coherence and strategic technical initiatives.

• This position is hybrid (Lehi, UT) or Remote (US-based).

• Reports to: Sr. Director of Engineering

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Technical Strategy & Architecture

- Own the multi-year technical vision for Payments, Scheduling, Forms, Business Experience and RCM application platforms, ensuring architectural decisions position Weave for scale, reliability, and competitive advantage.

- Drive architectural coherence across multiple teams, identifying and resolving cross-system dependencies and technical debt at the platform level.

- Lead technical due diligence for major initiatives, including build-vs-buy decisions, vendor evaluations, and platform migrations.

Cross-Team Problem Solving

- Identify and solve company-level technical problems that span organizational boundaries—the problems that are too complex, too cross-cutting, or too ambiguous for any single team to own.

- Compile information across systems, teams, and projects to develop comprehensive solutions with extensive validation, rollback, and testing plans.

- Forecast project costs in time, money, and opportunity cost; account for impacts across the business.

Strategic Technical Leadership

- Monitor the industry landscape, anticipate where high-scale customer experience and transactional platforms are heading, and ensure Weave stays ahead of the curve.

- Cut through noise and hype to identify genuine strategic value; advocate for and lead key initiatives that prepare Weave for emerging challenges.

- Shape company-wide standards for engineering excellence, observability, and reliability in distributed systems.

Mentorship & Organizational Capability

- Actively mentor Staff and Senior Engineers across the fellowship, developing the next generation of technical leaders.

- Elevate architectural thinking across teams through design reviews, documentation standards, and hands-on guidance.

- Build organizational capability that persists beyond your individual contributions.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 15+ years of software engineering experience with progressive technical leadership scope.

- Track record of leading cross-team technical initiatives that delivered measurable business outcomes.

- Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, build consensus across organizational boundaries, and translate technical tradeoffs into business terms.

- Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, including building and operating services that handle hundreds of millions of transactions and terabytes of data.

- Proven experience with event streaming and messaging infrastructure (Kafka, Google Pub/Sub, or similar) at significant scale.

- Strong background in scalable data stores—both relational (PostgreSQL at scale, Vitess, Spanner) and NoSQL (Bigtable, Redis, etc.).

- Operational experience with cloud-native infrastructure on GCP or AWS, including Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and highly available system design.

- Solid backend engineering foundation (Go preferred; Python, Java, or C# acceptable).

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- Background in compliance-heavy environments (healthcare, fintech) with experience navigating regulatory requirements in technical design.

- Experience shaping AI/ML infrastructure or integrating AI capabilities into production systems.

- History of external technical leadership: open source contributions, conference speaking, or published technical writing.

- Strong opinions, loosely held—you bring conviction to technical discussions while remaining genuinely open to better ideas.

- Expertise in data platform architecture: streaming pipelines, data lakes, warehouses, or distributed analytics.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
As our Product Operations Manager, you will report to the Head of Product Operations and play an important role in improving how our Product Development organization plans, collaborates, and delivers. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Design teams, you will help strengthen roadmap planning and execution, advance Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices, and drive meaningful operational improvements. You will bring a proactive, data-informed approach to identifying challenges, uncovering opportunities, and leading cross-functional initiatives that help teams make better decisions and operate more effectively. This is a hands-on role for an experienced Product Operations professional who enjoys solving operational challenges and helping teams deliver customer and business value.

- This position will be hybrid based out of our Lehi, UT HQ (3x per week)

- If outside of UT, periodic travel will be required to our Lehi, UT HQ.

- Reports to: Head of Product Operations

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Partner with Product and Engineering teams to strengthen quarterly roadmap planning, readiness, capacity visibility, and alignment on priorities.

- Facilitate planning and execution across assigned teams, clarifying ownership, milestones, and dependencies while proactively addressing risks and blockers.

- Independently lead assigned cross-functional initiatives, driving stakeholder alignment, accountability, and progress from planning through delivery.

- Partner with Product and Engineering Managers to improve dependency management, delivery forecasting, and alignment between product priorities and engineering constraints.

- Strengthen adoption of Product Development Lifecycle (PDLC) practices, standards, and ways of working to improve consistency and execution.

- Support product release and launch coordination, ensuring cross-functional readiness, clear ownership, and alignment with business stakeholders.

- Maintain and improve operational reporting and dashboards, translating performance data and stakeholder feedback into actionable insights and recommendations.

- Identify and implement improvements to Product Development processes, operating rhythms, and tools that reduce friction and improve effectiveness.

- Develop and refine Product Operations playbooks, templates, and best practices, providing practical guidance to support team adoption.opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen Product Development effectiveness.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 3–5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, Product Management, Engineering, or a related discipline within a SaaS or technology company.

- Demonstrated experience supporting roadmap planning and execution across Product and Engineering teams, including prioritization, capacity planning, and dependency management.

- Experience independently leading cross-functional product development initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, managing dependencies, and addressing execution risks.

- Experience improving operational processes, frameworks, and ways of working within Product Development organizations.

- Strong working knowledge of modern software development practices, methodologies, and lifecycles.

- Technical fluency with product development tools such as Linear or Jira and analytics platforms, with an understanding of engineering and delivery metrics.

- Strong analytical skills with experience developing operational reporting, interpreting performance data, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

- Strong business acumen with the ability to connect operational improvements to delivery effectiveness, customer value, and business outcomes.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment across Product, Engineering, and business teams.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, identify operational challenges, and drive practical improvements.

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- You are a self-starter who takes ownership of responsibilities and proactively addresses challenges.

- You have firsthand experience working with Product and Engineering teams and understand the realities of software development and delivery.

- You naturally identify gaps, connect information, and bring forward practical recommendations.

- You build trusted relationships through collaboration, communication, and follow-through.

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
At Weave, our People Operations team is passionate about taking care of our people, fostering positivity, and collaborating to build a supportive workplace. As a People Operations Generalist, you will be the go-to resource for day-to-day employee support while turning workforce data into clear insights that help our teams make smarter decisions. You will partner closely with HR Partners, Total Rewards, and Recruiting to keep our employee experience seamless and our HR systems accurate. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, this role blends hands-on HR operations with people analytics to support Weave’s continued growth.

- This position will be remote in Mexico

- Reports to: Director of People Operations

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Answer and resolve People Team tickets in our help desk system, escalating to specialists when needed

- Process employee transactions in Workday and related systems, such as new hires, job changes, and terminations

- Help to manage the People Data and ensure accuracy and fix errors

- Build and run recurring People reports in Workday and Google Sheets

- Run People analytics including: headcount, turnover, recruiting, and other workforce trends.

- Identify themes and stories that bring our data to life

- Spot common ticket themes and suggest updates to process documents and knowledge articles

- Follow data privacy and confidentiality practices for all employee information

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO ACCOMPLISH THE JOB

- 3+ years of experience in HR operations, an HR help desk, HR administration, or a similar role

- Hands-on experience processing transactions in Workday or another HRIS

- Experience working tickets in a help desk tool such as Jira or ServiceNow

- Strong spreadsheet skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups

- Fluent in written and spoken English, since you will answer employee questions and work daily with a US-based team

- Availability to work US Hours (Mountain Time Hours)

- Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate work on sensitive data

- Worked for a US-based company and supported US-based employees

WHAT WILL MAKE US LOVE YOU

- You have used Google Sheets as your main spreadsheet tool

- You have built reports or dashboards in Workday

- You explain answers clearly and kindly, even when the question is repeated

- You notice patterns in requests and speak up with ideas to fix the root cause

- You treat confidential information with care

- You are comfortable analyzing data and transforming in into meaningful stories

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.
